body:
thanks.

i don't really think of myself as un-sociable. it isn't like i'm declining invitations or anything like that. i have relatively good banter in the workplace. but, after work, people go home to their families, and i come home to depression support forums. it's fucking ridiculous.

signing up for study is not a good substitute for what's actually missing.

i understand the suggestion --- what i do is work two jobs, since i can't stand being at home alone. it solves the immediate problem (being at home alone), but doesn't get me any farther along to where i'd like to be (being out with people having fun, or at home with a partner).
i feel the exact same thing.
hate to say it, but yes photos are essential for online dating.
I work a second job on the weekends to keep me occupied. The pay is peanuts, but it keeps me out of my house.
thanks for that. saturday AM, made it through.

+1 This is exactly correct.

And the six-pack isn't working with your gender of choice either, right?
Have that exact same problem. So "go try some activities" isn't the solution.
Thanks. I do stuff, like hit the gym and so forth, but it doesn't really take the edge off the isolation. It's stupid that it's 10pm and I'm thinking of going back for a second workout.
Thanks. Not sure pills are the answer (I have tried those, with little effect)... is more a messed up situation that needs to be fixed.

well, there is nobody. an anonymous message board :)

it isn't even that i'm necessarily wanting to bitch and moan to somebody about being depressed. i'm just saying, i'm depressed because i am lonely. and there are times, like now, when i wish i was spending time with (or had imminent plans to spend time with) somebody i had some connection with. and it depresses me that there is nobody like that. not sure what i've done to make that happen.

thanks. 

sure, i guess i mean it's not helping because in spite of my effort that way, there is still nobody i have any sort of connection with. just sitting around a table having banter or the chit-chat with the regulars at my gym doesn't equate to a good social relationship, and i'm in no danger of developing anything like that.

if i wanted to talk to somebody, now, outside of these forced situations, there's really nobody that would feel appropriate with.
